chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin midang' tungah thu a khenmi aw, kuakua na hi zongin koihkhong theih na hikei hi. A hang pen nangma' mawhsak thute mah nangma'n bawl na hih manin midang khat' thu na khenna ah nangmahmah a kimawhsak na hi hi.
Tua bang nam a bawl mite' tungah thumaan thutak tawh kituakin Pasian' thukhenna tung cih i thei hi.
Tua banga a gamta mite mawhsak napi tua mawhnate nangma' pumpi tawh a bawl veve mipa aw, Pasian' thukhenna a pelh zo ding kisa na hi hiam?
Ahihkeileh Pasian' migitna pen kisikna na neih nading ahihlam phawk lo-in a dimlet Pasian' migitna, a thuakzawhna leh a lungduaina cihte a neu-ngaihsutkha na hi hiam?
Tua bangin kisik nuamlo-in na lungsim khauhna huhau-in hehna ni a kici, Pasian' thukhenna diktak hong kilat ding hun' adingin hehna a kholkhol na hi hi.
Pasian in mite khat ciat a sepna tawh kizui-in dinkik ding hi.
Lungduai cihtakna tawh nahoih semin minphatna, pahtawina, leh siattheihlohna a zong mite Pasian in tawntung nuntakna guan ding a,
angsung thei mite leh thumaan thutak mang lo-in siattatna thu a zui mite' ading ahihleh hehna leh lungsona om ding hi.
A tatsia mihing khempeuh, a masa-in Jew mite leh a zom ah Greek mite, a vekun gimna leh haksatna tuak ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin gamtat hoih mi khempeuh, a masa-in Jew mite leh a zom ah Greek mite, a vekun minphatna, pahtawina leh nopna lemna ngah ding uh hi.
A hang pen Pasian in guptuam paihtuam nei lo hi.
Thukhun' huamkhak loh hihna tawh a khialte khempeuh thukhun' huamkhak hihlohna mah tawh kisia veve ding uh a, thukhun nei-a khialte ahihleh thukhun siksanin kimawhsak ding hi.
A hang pen Pasian' muhna ah midik cihte pen thukhun a zate hilo-in thukhun a zui, diksakna a ngah dingte hizaw hi.
A hang pen thukhun a neilo Gentile mite in pianngeizia thu tawh thukhun ii kalh thute a sep uh ciangin amau mahmah amau' ading thukhun khat suak uh hi.
Amau' kitheihtawmna lungsim in zong teci pangin a buaithei lai a lungsim uh in amaute mawhsak zelin maisak zel a, tua pen a lungtang tung uhah zuih ding thukhun kigelh ahihlam a lak uh ahi hi.
Tua hi a, kong gen Lungdamna Thu mah bangin Pasian in tua ni ciangin mihingte' sunglam thusimte Khris Jesu tungtawnin thu khen ding hi.
Ahih hangin note in noleno Jew mi ka hi uh, thukhun a muangte leh Pasian a kisialhpihte ka hi uh na kicih uh a,
thukhun tawh hong kipantahte na hihna uh tawh noleno, Pasian' deihna a theite ka hi uh, a hoihzaw thu a khentheite ka hi uh, na kicih uh banah
khuamulote a lamlak, khuamial sunga om mite ii khuavak ci-in sunglam kimuangin,
mihaitatte a hilh a sek sya, naupangnote a pantah sya, thukhun sungah thutheihna leh thumaan thutak melsuah lim a nei ka hi uh, na kicih takpi uhleh,
no, midang a hilhte aw, noleno kihilh lo na hi uh hiam? Guk loh ding thu tangko kawm mahin nomaumah in gu na hi uh hiam?
No, angkawm theilo ding ci-in a hilh teng mah in angkawm na hi uh hiam? No, milim kihhuai a sa teng mah in milim biakna innte va luh na hi uh hiam?
No, thukhun a kisialhpihte in thukhun palsatna tawh Pasian na mindaisak uh hi.
A hang pen, “Note' hangin Gentile mite lakah Pasian' min kigendai hi,” ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua hi a, thukhun na zuih uhleh vun-atna pen note' ading a mannei takpi hi a, ahi zongin thukhun na palsat uhleh na vun-atna uh zong vun-atloh mah suak lel hi.
Tua ahih manin vun-atloh mi khat in thukhun sunga thute a zuih leh ama' vun-atlohna pen vun-atna mahin kisimsak lo ding ahi hiam?
Tua ahih manin pianpihin vun-atloh hinapi thukhun a zui om ahih manin tuate in no, lai-a kigelh thukhun leh vun-at ngeina nei napi-a a palsatte, hong mawhsak ding hi.
A hang pen puatham thu bek tawh Jew mi ahithei kuamah om lo a, vun-atna zong puatham thu leh pumpi thu hilo hi.

Jew mi cih pen a sunglam ah Jew ahite hi a, vun-atna zong thukhun laimal vai ahilo, kha tungtawnin lungsim tawh kisai thu ahi hi. Vun-at mite' ngah pahtakna pen mi' tungpan hilo-in Pasian' kiangpan ahi hi.
